feature.name: Shelter of the Faithful
feature.description: You and your companions can receive free healing and care at temples of your faith, and you can call upon priests for help.

name: Charlatan
startingEquipment: Tools of the con of your choice

feature.name: False Identity
feature.description: You have created a second identity, including documentation, established acquaintances, and disguises.

feature.name: Criminal Contact
feature.description: You have a reliable contact who acts as a liaison to a network of criminals.

feature.name: By Popular Demand
feature.description: You can always find a place to perform and receive free lodging and food of modest quality.

feature.name: Rustic Hospitality
feature.description: Common folk will shelter you and your companions, hide you, and won't betray you.

name: Guild Artisan
startingEquipment: Letter of introduction from your guild

feature.name: Guild Membership
feature.description: Your guild offers lodging, legal aid, and assistance — and expects dues and loyalty in return.

feature.name: Discovery
feature.description: Your solitude yielded a unique discovery — a great truth, a secret, or a hidden location.

feature.name: Position of Privilege
feature.description: People assume the best of you. You are welcome in high society and can secure an audience with a local noble.

feature.name: Wanderer
feature.description: You can find food and fresh water for yourself and up to 5 others each day, and recall the general layout of terrain.

feature.name: Researcher
feature.description: You know where to find obscure information. If you don't know it, you know who does.

feature.name: Ship's Passage
feature.description: You can secure free passage on sailing ships for yourself and companions in exchange for labor.

feature.name: Military Rank
feature.description: Soldiers loyal to your former faction recognize your rank. You can invoke your rank for influence and access to military camps.

feature.name: City Secrets
feature.description: You know the secret patterns of cities and can find passages through urban areas twice as fast as normal.
